about: One responsible team instead of a dozen shops

Furnishing on your own means months of trips, different suppliers, delays and items that do not match. We run all the furnishing as one team: a specification with item codes, sizes to fit your niches, a delivery schedule and quality control on receipt.
Part of the furniture, lighting and materials is shipped directly from factories in China — higher quality for the same money than ready-made retail furniture.
Turnkey furnishing at CAS starts from $250 per m². The exact amount is fixed in the specification after the design project: you see every item and its price before ordering.

faq: How much does turnkey furnishing cost?
From $250 per m². The exact amount is calculated from the specification after the design project, with a price for every item.
Can I furnish without a design project?
Yes, with a simple layout plan, but with a design project the furniture fits the dimensions exactly and works together. Design from $30 per m².
How does delivery from China work?
We order directly from factories, check quality and arrange delivery to Kyiv. Delivery from China takes 30–60 days.
